name: Key Bridge
description: Server-side helper for scarpet apps: copies each player's movement keys (W/A/S/D, jump, sneak, sprint) into the scoreboard objective 'keys', pushes a new server resource pack to everyone live (/packpush <url> <sha1> [prompt], /packpop; also with Polymer AutoHost), gives one player an upside-down camera (/flipcam start|move|stop; op level 2), bakes skins painted on the in-game easel (skinpaint.sc) into real, signed player skins (/skinbake <id> → PNG → MineSkin), and hides an entity tagged kbhide_<player> from that one player. No client mod needed.
